about: Limit: which international power limits apply to each transmitting group of a satellite Finland can see. A group is matched against the ITU's limit tables (spec/tables/pfd.json) on frequency, kind of station, date, orbit and protected area. A filing with no applicable limit leaves: there is nothing to compare it with.
tables_basis: ITU Radio Regulations Article 21 (Tables 21-4 and 21-5), Appendix 5 and related Resolutions, as tabulated by the Radiocommunication Bureau for its PFD examination (BR PFD Technical Annexes).
match: Frequency: the limit's band and the group's span (lowest to highest filed frequency) overlap, ends excluded.
Kind of station: the group's station classes (srv_cls) and the limit's classes (CLASSES_OF_STN, read in two-letter codes) share at least one.

Date: the group's date of protection (grp.d_prot_eff), or the date the ITU received the filing when that is not set, lies within the limit's dates. With no date at all, every date matches (worst case).
Orbit, moving satellites only: the steepest tilt and the highest apogee lie within the limit's windows. With no orbit filed, every window matches (worst case); the Data step then stops the filing.
Area: the limit protects an area that includes Finland (the list below).
areas_protecting_finland: ALL WORLD EXCEPT MEX AND USA
areas_basis: Administration policy, from the Radio Regulations: Finland is in Region 1 and is not one of the countries these exceptions name. Areas that protect only countries named in a footnote are not applied (guidebook L-3).
skip_basis: Limits stated against orbital separation protect other satellites, not the ground.

outcomes.limited: At least one international limit applies to what it transmits.
outcomes.no_frequency: It files no frequency for what it transmits, so no limit can be matched.
outcomes.named_countries_only: The only limits for its frequencies protect countries named in a footnote of the Radio Regulations, and Finland is not one of them.
outcomes.no_limit: No international limit covers its frequencies, kind of station and dates in Finland's area.

notes: A filing goes on if at least one of its groups has a limit. Outcomes are tried in the order above.
Each matching pair of a group and a limit is one row; the rows go on to the Data step.
